decisions.aperture: 宽：边框也换（推翻 FDB-DSP-014 禁止大面积）

finish_intent.7: champagne gold (Standard base; rarity tiers per cmf.rarity_tier_map)

cmf_scheme_a_zone_map.rule: raised = polished, flats = brushed, recessed = sandblasted; finishes meet on crisp geometric edges (Royal Oak anglage principle)

nested_offset_rule.rule: Every nested outline is the exact inward offset of its parent outline by the local wall/shelf width; corner arcs share the parent's arc centre (concentric) and chamfers stay parallel.
nested_offset_rule.validation: 05-blockout validation asserts every rounded-rect pair reports concentric=true

geometry_builder.bolt_construction: cylindrical head with hexagonal socket, seated in a counterbore cut into the crystal band (BOOLEAN EXACT, applied before bevel)

uniform_offset_rule.rule: Each steel island has ONE master outline (four equal 45-degree chamfers, interior.island_corner_chamfer_mm, junction fillets). Every nested contour is an exact inward offset: main bezel -> field (shelf) -> groove (+inset, +width); header bezel -> mirror bevel -> plate. Band widths are therefore equal on the sides, top, bottom and diagonals.
uniform_offset_rule.symmetry: rev-009: no wings; gold accents mirrored L/R and T/B; trait plaque centred; pocket centred on the field width.

junction_fillet_rule.rule: Every vertex where a 45-degree chamfer meets a straight edge is filleted (interior.junction_fillet_mm on the outer outline). Insets keep max(r - d, interior.junction_fillet_min_mm). Wing polygons are filleted at every vertex (main.wing_corner_fillet_mm).
junction_fillet_rule.sampling: each corner still emits seg+1 points, resampled by arc length over fillet-chamfer-fillet, so nested outlines bridge 1:1

trait_plaque_rule.rule: Raised brushed plaque with surround groove; three troughs (label column | 0-100 track | value column) top-down SPIN, FEEL, CRAFT; quartile tick notches; fill strips as separate runtime-dynamic objects authored at 100 % and shown at preview lengths.

level_stack_rule.rule: Inside each compartment the holder must read as distinct steps: bezel top -> 45-degree mirror chamfer -> recessed field -> engraved outline groove -> raised brushed wings/band (with surround groove) -> raised polished lip (outer chamfer, inner slope) -> smoke wall -> graphite floor. Every step is geometry with its own bevel; no step may be implied by shading alone.
level_stack_rule.engraving: grooves are BOOLEAN EXACT cuts of main.groove_width_mm x main.groove_depth_mm, applied before bevel
level_stack_rule.frame_profile: outer rounded lip + inner ledge stepped down case.frame_ledge_drop_mm (stepped ring, one watertight mesh)

validation_rules: Spinner source path and SHA-256 are required before Gate 04 approval.
Orthographic camera IDs must be exactly front, back, top, bottom, left, right.
Scene names and material IDs must be unique and must not contain Blender numeric suffixes.
Formula graph must be unit-safe and acyclic.
Transparent meshes must be watertight and must not contain coplanar nested faces.
frame_coverage_of_spinner_thickness plus spinner.protrusion_ratio must equal 1 within 0.001.
frame front height plus protrusion must equal spinner thickness within 0.01 mm.
Gold visible area must be between 5 and 8 percent and must not form a closed loop.
Soft focus may modify Beauty only and must ship with a clean comparison.
Any source or contract hash change marks the owning gate and all downstream gates stale.
Shipping previews must show the whole assembled case, never an exploded technical view.
